decontamination_notes: Real feature from pygments/pygments PR #3180, merged 2026-07-05, after the training cutoffs of the models this suite targets; re-check upstream_merged against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. Style color parsing (pygments/style.py colorformat) accepted hex colors and passed var()/calc() through but asserted on the CSS keyword 'transparent'; the HTML formatter's webify would also have hex-prefixed it. The fix (multi_file) accepts 'transparent' verbatim in style.py and passes it through webify in formatters/html.py. Third easy anchor for the difficulty band. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (076a6761) to the pygments package + pyproject.toml + LICENSE (dependency-free; base sandbox image, PYTHONPATH=.). Coverage: 3 fail_to_pass tests with styles defined inside each test (the base-time AssertionError fails each individually), verified failing at base and passing after the gold patch — acceptance through style_for_token for color/bg/border, verbatim CSS emission, and no hex mangling; 4 pass_to_pass guards pin hex handling (case-insensitive), var()/calc() pass-through, rejection of unknown color words (exception TYPE only), and default-style rendering. No message-text assertions.
